provenance: The shared dwemer database's api_keys schema is owned by ChimServer. SYNTH carries byte-identical copies of the shared migrations it consumes, so the version names recorded in dwemer_shared_migration_versions are the same fully qualified ChimServer names. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file bytes and equal migration_hashes in ChimServer's Config/DBManager/Schema/shared-pg17.json at the commit below. tools/shared-api-keys.php status verifies them; never edit a copy here.
